title: Lane Board
description: The standing state file for a multi-lane work session. Written by the orchestrator on every lane transition. Renderers read this file; they never write it.

session.description: Stable identifier for the work session this board belongs to.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent write to this file. Must be bumped on every write.

notes.description: Freeform board-level notes (e.g. session-wide blockers, decisions in flight). Not a per-lane field.

lanes.description: One entry per active or historical lane in this session.

id.description: Stable short identifier for the lane, unique within the board.

title.description: One-line human-readable description of what the lane is doing.

type.description: Whether the lane is being executed by an agent/delegate or by a person.

name.description: Role-scoped label for the owner (e.g. 'delegate', 'reviewer', 'coordinator'), not a proper noun.

model.description: Model tier or identifier running the lane, if the owner is an agent. Null for human-owned lanes.

state.description: Fixed lifecycle enum. A lane that doesn't fit one of these needs to be split, not given a new ad hoc value.

phase.description: Which wave/phase of the larger plan this lane belongs to, if the session has phases.

deps.description: Lane ids this lane depends on (must reach a mergeable state before this lane can proceed).

pr.description: Identifier or URL for the lane's associated change request, if one has been opened.

blockedOn.description: Free-text description of the specific thing blocking this lane. Required in practice whenever state is 'blocked'.

startedAt.description: Timestamp the lane transitioned into 'running' for the first time. Null for lanes still 'planned'.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent transition for this lane specifically.

next.description: One-line statement of the next concrete action for this lane.
